# Public robustness benchmark (arXiv 2503.18445), run as published

Purpose: Table 5 of the IEEE Access draft lists only numbers produced with the public
evaluation code of the benchmark (request inbox `20261104-134358`, DRN-261027-01).

The benchmark README says: clone DELIVER and replace `val_mm.py` with these scripts. Our own
`semseg/` differs from DELIVER (augmentations, metrics, loader), so it is not used for data,
corruption or scoring here.

## Variants (generated by `make_variants.py`, diffs next to each file)
- `run_upstream/` = upstream + two parameter lines read from env (`MMSSB_RMM_R`, default 0.25;
  `MMSSB_NM_LEVEL`, default 0). The published scripts hard-code `r = 0.25` and `level = 0`.
  Run inside an unmodified DELIVER `b3a76c3` checkout (CMNeXt reproduction check).
- `ours/ours_val_mm_*.py` = run_upstream + bootstrap (sys.path) + four import lines pointing to
  `bench_upstream/` + model construction via `ours/ours_model.py` (builds with `val.load_model`,
  returns logits only). Corruption, scoring and E(p) code are unchanged.

## Facts read from the published code (commit above)
- EMM and RMM: single forward pass (`sliding = False`), labels resized with the input to
  `EVAL.IMAGE_SIZE`, `Metrics` from DELIVER, mIoU over 25 classes.
- NM: also `sliding = False` in `evaluate_noisy_modality` (no flip averaging), S&P on all four
  inputs, then Gaussian on RGB, depth and LiDAR. Noise and RMM masks are not seeded.
- EMM Avg covers the 15 subsets with at least one sensor present; clean = the subset with none missing.

## Run (bengio example)
```bash
# CMNeXt check (inside DELIVER b3a76c3 checkout with run_upstream/*.py copied in)
python val_mm_EMM.py --cfg <cmnext cfg>
# ours
OURS_REPO=<repo> PYTHONPATH=<pylibs>:<repo>/semseg/models/sam2 python ours/ours_val_mm_EMM.py --cfg <ours cfg>
MMSSB_RMM_R=0.75 ... ours/ours_val_mm_RMM.py ;  MMSSB_NM_LEVEL=2 ... ours/ours_val_mm_NM.py
```
Results are written by the scripts to `eval_<time>.txt` next to `EVAL.MODEL_PATH`.
